Install guides

Install Maktaba on a Synology NAS

On DSM 7.2 or newer, Maktaba runs as one Container Manager project. It takes about 15 minutes, and Maktaba updates itself after that.

  • About 15 minutes
  • DSM 7.2 or newer
  • 4 GB of memory or more

On this page

  1. Before you start
  2. Your NAS
  3. Step by step
  4. After setup

Before you start

  • A DSM account with administrator rights, and Container Manager from Package Center.
  • An SSD volume, if the NAS has one: Maktaba keeps its database there, and browsing is faster.
  • The shared folders that hold your videos, and which of them Maktaba may write to.

Your NAS

Answer a few questions about your NAS, and the page writes the project file for you.

Tip: Your answers stay in this page. Nothing you type is sent anywhere.

Step by step

  1. Make a user for Maktaba

    In Control Panel → User & Group, create the user maktaba, with a strong password and no administrator rights.

  2. Make Maktaba’s folder

    In File Station, create the folder maktaba inside the shared folder docker, and give the user maktaba Read/Write on it.

    Warning: If the user maktaba can’t write to docker/maktaba, the project stops at once. Its log names the folder: give that user Read/Write there and start the project again.

  3. Share your video folders

    In Control Panel → Shared Folder, give maktaba Read only on each folder of videos, or Read/Write where Maktaba may save subtitles.

  4. Create the project

    In Container Manager → Project → Create, name it maktaba, choose the path docker/maktaba, paste the project file, then Next and Done.

    The project file: compose.yaml
    services:
  maktaba:
    image: ghcr.io/hamza-labs-core/maktaba-server:latest
    container_name: maktaba
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: "1026:100"
    stop_grace_period: 90s
    mem_limit: 4g
    environment:
      MAKTABA_PLATFORM: dsm
      TZ: Asia/Riyadh
    network_mode: host
    volumes:
      - /volume1/docker/maktaba:/var/lib/maktaba
      - /volume1/Movies:/volume1/Movies:ro

  5. Finish the setup

    When the project runs, open its terminal (Container → maktaba → Details → Terminal → Create) and run:

    In the container’s terminal
    /opt/maktaba/server/bin/maktaba-server container setup

After setup

Maktaba now runs on the NAS. Open it from any browser at home, and it takes you through the rest.

After setup: updates and quiet hours

Maktaba keeps a household’s films and series on its own computer, and plays them on every screen at home, in Arabic and English. Free and open source, under the MIT licence.
